project.title: Stabilization Pond Raw sequence reads
project.description: Metagenomic sequencing from stabilization ponds of two small dairy industries in Santa Fe, Argentina. First industry, AUR, has two serial ponds (AUR1 and AUR2), while the second industry, CYC, has four serial ponds (CYC1-4).
